card.name: Missed or delayed dose wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, is, if, patient) right before a word about a delayed or missed dose, such as 'delaying' or 'missed'. It appears in 'Missed Dose' subsections and in vaccination-before-first-dose warnings.

modes.label: Missed dose sentence
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'patient' just before 'missed' or 'misses' in a missed-dose instruction.

modes.label: Risks of delaying therapy
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'risks' where the next word is 'delaying' in a vaccination-before-first-dose warning.
modes.example: unless the risks<< of>> delaying therapy outweigh the risks of developing mening

modes.label: Vaccinate if needed
modes.description: The word 'if' after 'vaccinate' in meningococcal vaccination requirements.
modes.example: and vaccinate<< if>> needed according to current ACIP recommendations two

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward delay, postponing or skipping words, and away from submit or payment words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text talks about a missed or delayed dose.
